item.title: Guessing the Jev Architecture
item.description: TypeSafe has released Jev, a ‘System One’ model that returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text. The architecture is not public. Here is the one I would bet on — a bidirectional encoder over the state, plus a language-conditioned cross-attention head that scores every candidate answer in parallel.
